title: Tobi and the Last Cookie
logline: A tiny robot vacuum named Tobi discovers a single cookie crumb under the sofa and must decide whether to share it.
style_lock: Disney-Pixar 3D animated feature film aesthetic, soft volumetric warm lighting, subsurface scattering on skin and fabric, large expressive eyes with multiple catchlights, stylized but believable proportions, rich material detail, shallow depth of field with creamy bokeh, warm cozy palette of cream, butter yellow, dusty pink and soft sage

lock.form: small round robot vacuum, 30 cm wide, matte butter-yellow shell, white rubber bumper ring
lock.face: two oversized glossy dark-blue eyes with three catchlights each, thin rounded eyebrow lines that move, no mouth
lock.signature: tiny antenna with a pink bobble on top, a small dent on the left side of the shell
lock.palette: butter yellow, cream white, dusty pink bobble

lock.form: girl about 8 years old, slightly larger head, soft rounded features
lock.face: big warm-brown eyes with multiple catchlights, light freckles across the nose bridge
lock.hair: dark curly hair in two puffs tied with mint-green ribbons
lock.outfit: mustard-yellow knit cardigan over a white tee, denim shorts, red sneakers

settings.lock: sunlit cozy living room, sheer cream curtains, beige sofa with a knitted throw, wooden floor, potted fern in a terracotta pot, golden-hour window light from camera-left

scenes.action: Tobi rolls out from under the sofa, stops, and his eyes widen as he spots a single cookie crumb
scenes.camera: static, then a very slow push in
scenes.vo: Tobi had cleaned this room a thousand times.

scenes.shot: medium shot, Lena kneeling beside Tobi
scenes.action: Lena tiptoes in, spots the same crumb, and she and Tobi freeze, staring at each other and at the crumb
scenes.vo: But today, someone else wanted that crumb too.

scenes.shot: wide shot of both on the floor, crumb between them
scenes.action: Tobi nudges the crumb toward Lena, she smiles, breaks off a tiny piece and places it on his bumper; they both beam
scenes.vo: So he shared it. And that was the sweetest part.
